meanings.en: to discover the meaning of something difficult to read or understand
meanings.exampleEn: It took me a while to decipher his messy handwriting.
meanings.exampleTr: Onun dağınık el yazısını çözmek biraz zamanımı aldı.

meanings.en: to remove official controls or restrictions from something
meanings.exampleEn: The government decided to decontrol prices in the energy sector.
meanings.exampleTr: Hükümet enerji sektöründe fiyatların denetimini kaldırmaya karar verdi.

meanings.en: an official order given by a person with authority
meanings.exampleEn: The king issued a decree banning all public gatherings.
meanings.exampleTr: Kral tüm toplu buluşmaları yasaklayan bir kararname çıkardı.

meanings.en: to order something officially
meanings.exampleEn: The court decreed that the property should be sold.
meanings.exampleTr: Mahkeme mülkün satılmasına hükmetti.

meanings.en: to give all your time or energy to a particular activity or purpose
meanings.exampleEn: She decided to dedicate her life to helping the poor.
meanings.exampleTr: Hayatını yoksullara yardım etmeye adamaya karar verdi.

meanings.en: able to be defeated or overcome
meanings.exampleEn: The champion seemed unstoppable, but he proved to be defeatable.
meanings.exampleTr: Şampiyon durdurulamaz görünüyordu ama yenilebilir olduğunu kanıtladı.

meanings.en: expecting or accepting failure before making an effort
meanings.exampleEn: Stop being so defeatist; we still have a chance to win.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu kadar bozguncu olmayı bırak; hâlâ kazanma şansımız var.

meanings.en: unable to protect yourself from attack or harm
meanings.exampleEn: The soldiers attacked a defenceless village.
meanings.exampleTr: Askerler savunmasız bir köye saldırdı.

meanings.en: the act of delaying something until a later time
meanings.exampleEn: The company requested a deferral of the tax payment.
meanings.exampleTr: Şirket vergi ödemesinin ertelenmesini talep etti.

meanings.en: delayed until a later time
meanings.exampleEn: They offered a deferred payment plan for new customers.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni müşteriler için ertelenmiş ödeme planı sundular.

meanings.en: to make something dirty or no longer pure, especially something sacred
meanings.exampleEn: Vandals defiled the ancient temple with graffiti.
meanings.exampleTr: Vandallar antik tapınağı grafitiyle kirletti.

meanings.en: to make something change direction, especially by hitting it
meanings.exampleEn: The goalkeeper managed to deflect the ball away from the net.
meanings.exampleTr: Kaleci topu kaleden uzağa saptırmayı başardı.

meanings.en: to turn attention or criticism away from something
meanings.exampleEn: She tried to deflect attention from her own mistakes.
meanings.exampleTr: Kendi hatalarından dikkati başka yöne çekmeye çalıştı.

meanings.en: to change or spoil the normal shape of something
meanings.exampleEn: The intense heat can deform plastic components.
meanings.exampleTr: Yoğun ısı plastik parçaların şeklini bozabilir.

meanings.en: a part of the body that is not the normal shape because of injury or disease
meanings.exampleEn: The disease left him with a permanent deformity in his hand.
meanings.exampleTr: Hastalık elinde kalıcı bir şekil bozukluğu bıraktı.

meanings.en: to make frozen food or a freezer become warmer and no longer frozen
meanings.exampleEn: Remember to defrost the chicken before you cook it.
meanings.exampleTr: Pişirmeden önce tavuğun buzunu çözmeyi unutma.

meanings.en: in a skilful and quick way
meanings.exampleEn: She deftly sliced the vegetables into thin pieces.
meanings.exampleTr: Sebzeleri ustaca ince parçalara doğradı.

meanings.en: a feeling of unhappiness and low spirits
meanings.exampleEn: A sense of dejection settled over the team after the loss.
meanings.exampleTr: Yenilgiden sonra takımı bir keder duygusu sardı.

meanings.en: a person whose job is to bring goods to people's homes or workplaces
meanings.exampleEn: The delivery person left the package at the front door.
meanings.exampleTr: Teslimatçı paketi ön kapıya bıraktı.

meanings.en: the way a person behaves and looks to others
meanings.exampleEn: Despite the bad news, she kept a calm demeanour.
meanings.exampleTr: Kötü habere rağmen sakin bir tavır sergiledi.

meanings.en: a fault or disadvantage; a mark against someone for bad behaviour
meanings.exampleEn: The teacher gave him a demerit for talking in class.
meanings.exampleTr: Öğretmen sınıfta konuştuğu için ona eksi puan verdi.

meanings.tr: yıkıcı, yıkım yapan kişi ya da araç
meanings.en: a person or thing that demolishes or destroys buildings
meanings.exampleEn: The demolisher brought down the old factory in a single day.
meanings.exampleTr: Yıkıcı, eski fabrikayı tek günde yerle bir etti.

meanings.en: a person who takes part in a public protest
meanings.exampleEn: Thousands of demonstrators gathered outside the parliament.
meanings.exampleTr: Binlerce gösterici meclisin önünde toplandı.

meanings.en: a person who shows how something works or is used
meanings.exampleEn: The demonstrator showed us how to use the new blender.
meanings.exampleTr: Tanıtımcı bize yeni blenderin nasıl kullanılacağını gösterdi.

meanings.en: to make someone lose confidence or hope
meanings.exampleEn: The constant criticism began to demoralize the whole team.
meanings.exampleTr: Sürekli eleştiri tüm takımın moralini bozmaya başladı.

meanings.en: having lost confidence or hope
meanings.exampleEn: After losing three games in a row, the players felt demoralized.
meanings.exampleTr: Üst üste üç maç kaybettikten sonra oyuncular morali bozuk hissetti.

meanings.en: causing someone to lose confidence or hope
meanings.exampleEn: It was a demoralizing defeat for the young team.
meanings.exampleTr: Genç takım için moral bozucu bir yenilgiydi.

meanings.en: quiet, shy, and behaving in a modest way, especially of a woman
meanings.exampleEn: She gave a demure smile and looked away.
meanings.exampleTr: Utangaç bir gülümseme verip başını çevirdi.

meanings.en: a hollow mark in a surface made by hitting or pressing it
meanings.exampleEn: There was a small dent in the side of the car.
meanings.exampleTr: Arabanın yan tarafında küçük bir göçük vardı.

meanings.en: to make a hollow mark in a hard surface
meanings.exampleEn: He accidentally dented the door with his bike.
meanings.exampleTr: Bisikletiyle yanlışlıkla kapıda göçük yaptı.

meanings.en: to be affected or decided by something
meanings.exampleEn: Our plans for tomorrow depend on the weather.
meanings.exampleTr: Yarınki planlarımız havaya bağlı.

meanings.en: to trust someone to help or support you
meanings.exampleEn: You can always depend on your friends in hard times.
meanings.exampleTr: Zor zamanlarda her zaman arkadaşlarına güvenebilirsin.

meanings.en: the quality of being able to be trusted and relied on
meanings.exampleEn: Customers value the dependability of our delivery service.
meanings.exampleTr: Müşteriler teslimat hizmetimizin güvenilirliğine değer veriyor.

meanings.en: the state of needing something or someone in order to survive or function
meanings.exampleEn: The country's dependency on oil imports is a serious problem.
meanings.exampleTr: Ülkenin petrol ithalatına bağımlılığı ciddi bir sorun.

meanings.en: to make something less personal or human
meanings.exampleEn: Large bureaucracies can depersonalize the way people are treated.
meanings.exampleTr: Büyük bürokrasiler insanlara davranış biçimini kişiliksizleştirebilir.

meanings.en: a picture or description of someone or something
meanings.exampleEn: The film's depiction of war is brutally realistic.
meanings.exampleTr: Filmin savaş tasviri acımasızca gerçekçi.

meanings.en: a reduction in the amount of something, especially a resource
meanings.exampleEn: The depletion of natural resources threatens future generations.
meanings.exampleTr: Doğal kaynakların tükenmesi gelecek nesilleri tehdit ediyor.

meanings.en: to strongly disapprove of something and criticize it
meanings.exampleEn: Most people deplore violence of any kind.
meanings.exampleTr: Çoğu insan her türlü şiddeti şiddetle kınar.

meanings.en: the act of forcing someone to leave a country, usually because they have broken the law
meanings.exampleEn: He is facing deportation after his visa expired.
meanings.exampleTr: Vizesinin süresi dolduktan sonra sınır dışı edilmeyle karşı karşıya.

meanings.en: the act of laughing at someone or something in a scornful way
meanings.exampleEn: His proposal was met with derision from the committee.
meanings.exampleTr: Önerisi komiteden alayla karşılandı.

meanings.en: the thick layer of skin below the surface layer
meanings.exampleEn: The dermis contains blood vessels, nerves, and hair follicles.
meanings.exampleTr: Derma kan damarları, sinirler ve kıl köklerini içerir.

meanings.en: the act of moving down to a lower level or position
meanings.exampleEn: The plane began its descent towards the airport.
meanings.exampleTr: Uçak havaalanına doğru inişine başladı.

meanings.en: the origin of a person, traced through their family
meanings.exampleEn: She is of Irish descent on her mother's side.
meanings.exampleTr: Anne tarafından İrlanda kökenlidir.

meanings.en: able to be described in words
meanings.exampleEn: The beauty of the scene was barely describable.
meanings.exampleTr: Manzaranın güzelliği zar zor tarif edilebilirdi.

meanings.en: to damage or treat a sacred place or object with disrespect
meanings.exampleEn: Thieves desecrated several graves in the old cemetery.
meanings.exampleTr: Hırsızlar eski mezarlıkta birkaç mezara saygısızlık etti.

meanings.tr: asker kaçağı, firari, terk eden kişi
meanings.en: a person who leaves the armed forces or a duty without permission
meanings.exampleEn: The deserter was caught trying to cross the border.
meanings.exampleTr: Firari, sınırı geçmeye çalışırken yakalandı.

meanings.en: the act of leaving someone or something, especially the armed forces, without intending to return
meanings.exampleEn: He was charged with desertion during wartime.
meanings.exampleTr: Savaş zamanında firar suçlamasıyla yargılandı.

meanings.en: in a way that is deserved or earned
meanings.exampleEn: She deservedly won the award for best actress.
meanings.exampleTr: En iyi kadın oyuncu ödülünü hak ederek kazandı.

meanings.en: to choose someone or something for a particular purpose or role
meanings.exampleEn: The area has been designated as a national park.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu bölge milli park olarak belirlendi.

meanings.en: chosen or marked out for a particular purpose
meanings.exampleEn: Please smoke only in the designated areas.
meanings.exampleTr: Lütfen yalnızca belirlenmiş alanlarda sigara için.

meanings.en: to stop doing something
meanings.exampleEn: They were ordered to desist from further construction.
meanings.exampleTr: Daha fazla inşaattan vazgeçmeleri emredildi.
